SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LINE_LOCATION_ID, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS REVISION_NUM, COUNT(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_9 = '*' GROUP BY KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NVL(STATUS ,'D') AS STATUS , NVL(LEGACY_PO_NO ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO , NVL(LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO ,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , NVL(CURRENCY_CODE ,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE , NVL(UNIT_PRICE ,0) AS UNIT_PRICE , NVL(ITEM_QTY ,0) AS ITEM_QTY , NVL(ITEM_AMT ,0) AS ITEM_AMT , NVL(ADD_DATE ,' ') AS ADD_DATE , NVL(RD_DATE ,' ') AS RD_DATE , NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION ,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , NVL(PURCHASER_USER_ID ,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID , NVL(LAST_NAME ,' ') AS LAST_NAME , NVL(LEGACY_PRNO ,' ') AS LEGACY_PRNO , NVL(REQ_USER_NAME ,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME , NVL(TO_CHAR(LINE_LOCATION_ID) ,0) AS LINE_LOCATION_ID , NVL(TO_CHAR(REVISION_NUM),0) AS REVISION_NUM , NVL(POSTAL_CODE ,' ') AS POSTAL_CODE , NVL(DELY_TO_ADDRESS ,' ') AS DELY_TO_ADDRESS , NVL(ETC1 ,' ') AS ETC1 , NVL(ETC2 ,' ') AS ETC2 , NVL(ETC3 ,' ') AS ETC3 , NVL(EMAIL_ADDRESS ,' ') AS EMAIL_ADDRESS , NVL(OFFICE_PHONE ,' ') AS OFFICE_PHONE , NVL(MOBILE_PHONE ,' ') AS MOBILE_PHONE , 'N' AS LEGACY_END_YN, '$G_RS.LEGACY_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM KEPPO, XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = TO_CHAR(LINE_LOCATION_ID) AND KEY_2 = TO_CHAR(REVISION_NUM) AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LINE_LOCATION_ID$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.REVISION_NUM$' AND KEY_9 = '*' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ) UNION ALL SELECT '' AS STATUS , '' AS LEGACY_PO_NO , '' AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , '' AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , '' AS CURRENCY_CODE , 0 AS UNIT_PRICE , 0 AS ITEM_QTY , 0 AS ITEM_AMT , '' AS ADD_DATE , '' AS RD_DATE , '' AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , '' AS PURCHASER_USER_ID , '' AS LAST_NAME , '' AS LEGACY_PRNO , '' AS REQ_USER_NAME , KEY_1 AS LINE_LOCATION_ID , KEY_2 AS REVISION_NUM , '' AS POSTAL_CODE , '' AS DELY_TO_ADDRESS , '' AS ETC1 , '' AS ETC2 , '' AS ETC3 , '' AS EMAIL_ADDRESS , '' AS OFFICE_PHONE , '' AS MOBILE_PHONE , 'Y' AS LEGACY_END_YN, '$G_RS.LEGACY_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LINE_LOCATION_ID$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.REVISION_NUM$' AND KEY_9 = '*' GROUP BY KEY_1, KEY_2
UPDATE XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LINE_LOCATION_ID$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.REVISION_NUM$' AND KEY_9 = '*'
UPDATE XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LINE_LOCATION_ID$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.REVISION_NUM$' AND KEY_9 = '*'
